fix(camellia): send specification device list

Summary:
- Add the specification device_list type to the API client exports.
- Initialize the specification editor device checkboxes from device_list when
  page or inspect data provides it.
- Keep match_model in sync while sending selected device records to
  specification.modify.

Rationale:
- The modify endpoint needs the selected applicable device records, not only
  the legacy comma-separated names.
- Preserving the existing device records avoids losing server fields such as
  id, state, seq, and timestamps when saving edits.

Tests:
- just camellia typecheck
- just camellia check
